title: Solmar's Hub (Updated 9/5/26)
features:
⚠ Must join the discord to claim a free key

NOTE: Some features may not work on low UNC executors like XENO, also DO NOT use firerate modifier as it will cause your weapons to not cause damage (will be fixed soon)  / The script will receive more updates and will remain free, feel free to leave suggestions on what to add either in the comments here or in the discord server

/ If you want a good config just enable Silent Aim and Wallbang 

X Combat Tab
- Silent Aim
- Configurable target hitbox: Head, HumanoidRootPart, UpperTorso, 
- Configurable Silent Aim FOV
- FOV circle
- Team Check
- Automatic prediction using ping, distance, and bullet speed
- Manual prediction
- Configurable bullet speed for prediction
- Magic Bullet (OP)
- Wallbang / shooting through walls
- Trigger Bot
- Configurable Trigger Bot FOV
- Rapid Fire
- Configurable fire delay from 1–50 ms
X ESP Tab
- ESP toggle
- Team-colored ESP
- Box ESP
- Player name ESP
- Health bars
- Distance ESP
- Equipped weapon ESP
- Skeleton ESP
- Head Dot ESP
- Tracelines
- Chams / player highlights through walls
X Player Tab
- Fly (lowkey detected)
- Configurable Fly Speed
- Noclip
- Anti-AFK
X Exploits Tab
- Horse Speed Hack (bit buggy)
- Configurable horse speed
